subject.title: fix(agents): skip model-override repair and visibility gate for locked sessions

question: Should this PR remain blocked until the durable-lock scope is fully verified and a real adopted-session send is demonstrated?
rationale: The repository requires direct Codex contract inspection for this behavior, and automated checks alone do not prove the reported Control UI workflow after the fix.

options.title: Require contract and live proof
options.body: Keep the PR open and blocked until the lock predicate is proven against all creators and a redacted adopted-session send succeeds in a real setup.

options.title: Accept the broad lock contract
options.body: Explicitly approve `modelSelectionLocked: true` as sufficient authorization to bypass generic model visibility, while still requiring real behavior proof.

recommendation.title: Require contract and live proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open and blocked until the lock predicate is proven against all creators and a redacted adopted-session send succeeds in a real setup.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice affects the core agent/session provider-routing contract and needs an established repository owner rather than the external proposer.
